input.task: Refresh the filing widget and read the document identifier.

provenance: T-M42-14's committed running demonstration, promoted to the missing executable invariant. The Refresh click is a literal no-op. A host timer scheduled before the action replaces the widget iframe's document in place after 1.5s; the Playwright Frame remains live and its URL remains about:srcdoc. Before the fix, check_state reads the successor document, sees Filing loaded, records postcondition_ok true, then the main-document extraction returns NIMBUS-10K-2025 and the run reports success with every verifier check green. The action earned credit from a document it never touched.

triage.note: The guard must identify the resolved document instance, not only its still-live Frame or same URL. A successor document is unverifiable; it must not satisfy the action's postcondition or unlock a read-only repair.
